description: Declared Portal 2 Linux x86_64 native Vulkan High qualification profile; complete image and performance acceptance remain unverified.

intent.support_scope: High qualification on the current desktop; not renderer parity or platform support evidence
intent.packaging: Waf-installed private Linux runtime with separately supplied licensed Portal 2 content

high.description: Native-resolution High, full accepted image, baked indirect default. Experimental handoff is exercised for qualification, not a shipped-default claim.

declared_off_terms.decision: user direction 2026-10-06: Source 2 lighting parity at Source 2 cost (RFC 0016 Source 2 lighting defaults)

terms.area-lights: r_core_area_lights 0: LTC area lights compiled out (no view area lights, kViewAreas off); fixtures keep their emissive surfaces and baked light
terms.gtao: r_core_ao_quality 0: kSurfaceAmbientOcclusion compiled out; material AO and the bake's occlusion remain
terms.ssr: r_core_ssr 0: the SSR targets' variant is not used; reflection probes alone
terms.soft-shadows: r_core_shadow_pcss 0: PCSS compiled out (kSurfaceViewSoftShadows); every runtime shadow takes the hard 2x2 filter; baked masks unchanged (term sweep: 15.9 ms at 4K, mean dE 0.92)
terms.probe-bounce: r_core_probe_bounce 0: the probe volume's projected-light bounce compiled out (kSurfaceViewProbeBounce; term sweep: 4.9 ms at 4K, no visible change on intro4)

high.required_image_coverage: RFC 0016 K11/K12 and R91: world, static and animated models, full shadows/material coverage, glass/water, decals, particles, beams, sky, post, UI and nested views; rejected or missing cohorts cannot pass.

low.description: Low: no runtime direct light or shadow atlas. The world draws the bake's total lightmap layer, whose direct light and shadows are baked, so lights stay static but present; runtime lights add only specular. Declared intent; no performance or image qualification yet.
low.required_image_coverage: As High, with every light's direct light from the total lightmap layer instead of runtime shading; switching r_core_runtime_direct in a running map must change the image without a reload.

required_checks: Native lifecycle/presentation and installed-package checks before support claims

evidence.note: Dependency/toolchain pins select the existing Linux native profile for this declared product slice. They do not certify the current build. The first laser route is not complete workload/image coverage. No existing 1024x768 or incomplete core capture certifies High.
